text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm working in my office as usual when...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, uhhh... Excuse me...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Do you like chocolate, Big Brother?
Does it make
you happy when you
receive some?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Do you like chocolate, Big Sister? Does
it make
you happy when you receive
some?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As soon as I hear the word "chocolate," I

remember that today's Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: R-really?! Hehe, then I'll be right back!
choice_data_list: That might actually make me happy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower runs off without another
word.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A little later...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thud!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She builds a veritable mountain of
chocolates on
my desk.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I made a lot. Some milk chocolates,
some dark...
some with nuts, some with
strawberries...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pick whichever you want!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pick whichever you want!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. You don't want to eat a flavor you
don't
like, right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That's why I made so many... Your
favorite kind
has to be in there
somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like Rice Shower put a lot of
effort into
making sure I had a good
Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh... what's wrong? Did I not make your
favorite?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Can you even eat all of them?!
choice_data_list: Would it be okay if I took all of them?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Are you... really sure?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seems worried about the taste. I
should ease
her concerns...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sure!
choice_data_list: Help me out if push comes to shove.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Heehee... I can eat a ton. Let me know
right away
when you've had too much!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad I made them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I eat my first Valentine's Day chocolate
while Rice
Shower intensely watches me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seems worried about the taste. I
should ease
her concerns...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
choice_data_list: Because I want to take in all of your feelings, Rice.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You don't have to...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But... if these chocolates represent my
feelings,
then I should have made more.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
This isn't nearly enough to show how
much you
mean to me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
This isn't nearly enough to show how
much you
mean to me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I spend a sweet Valentine's Day
with Rice
Shower.
